stem:
Biting flies can transmit diseases and cause loss of blood for animals in nature. Horses have developed behaviors to repel biting flies such as ear twitching, head tossing, leg stomping, and tail swishing.

Which statement best describes the interaction between body systems that allows horses to repel biting flies?

options.label: A
options.text: The nervous system senses the biting flies and sends a signal to the muscular system to move.

options.label: B
options.text: The circulatory system senses the biting flies and sends a signal to the nervous system to move.

options.label: C
options.text: The muscular system senses the biting flies and sends a signal to the integumentary system to move.

options.label: D
options.text: The integumentary system senses the biting flies and sends a signal to the circulatory system to move.
